text: The Clock Tower Trail is a pedestrian walking route along existing sidewalks and laneways in downtown Toronto. This loop through the Bay Cloverhill and Church Wellesley neighbourhoods connects residents to existing and new parks, public spaces, and public art. Teams from City Planning, Parks and Recreation, and Transportation Services have worked with the members of Bay Cloverhill Community Association to determine this route. "The Clock Tower Trail" name is inspired by the historic St. Charles Clock Tower at 484 to 488 Yonge Street. This loop extends north and south on both sides of Yonge Street between Charles Street East and McGill Street. On the east side, the trail runs south from George Hislop Park to Joseph Sheard Parkette, while on the west side, the trail runs north from College Park, turning north through Dr. Lilliam McGregor Park, Clover Hill Park and St. Mary Street…
